unconfirmed_sport_ids_note: Numeric IDs for the other twelve in-scope sports were not exposed in any page read first-hand. They are left blank rather than guessed.
ordering_rule_published_by_olbg: Default ordering is by number of community tips received; the percentage shown is the share of tips on that selection, and the Value Rating compares a selection's odds with the share of tips it holds.
note: OLBG community tip percentages are recorded here only as a description of how the source site presents a market. They are never used as an input to an originated price on this desk.
